deploy-bot: STARTING deploy to sandbox: env=sandbox ref=release/sandbox/kernel-opt-1.2.3 tag=v1.2.3-rc4 commit=3f4b9c2
maria: ack, kicking off smoke tests
kevin: ETA for smoke? any migrations?
maria: no migrations, config flag --enable-kvcache remains off for sandbox
deploy-bot: smoke tests running: job=smoke-suite-42 run_id=smoke-2161234567
sophie: watching telemetry — will ping if mem climbs
deploy-bot: smoke tests: step=generate_tokens status=PASS latency_p50=120ms
deploy-bot: smoke tests: step=throughput status=WARN throughput_drop=12% details=slight cpu steal on node-gpu-7
ryan: saw a spike in resident memory on node-gpu-7 ~+1.1GB starting at 10:03 UTC
maria: can we pin the model variant to quantized-v2 while we investigate? That should be compatible.
jamal: +1 pin to quantized-v2 for canary
maria: @deploy-bot, pause canary and pin variant=quantized-v2 for sandbox canary group A
deploy-bot: ACTION: pausing canary rollout for sandbox
deploy-bot: APPLIED: model_variant=quantized-v2 pinned for canary group A; rollback=false
kevin: opening ticket INF-3421 with logs and heap dump link: https://internal/tickets/INF-3421
sophie: I'll keep watch, if memory stabilizes we can resume, otherwise rollback to v1.2.2
deploy-bot: smoke tests resumed under pinned variant: all checks PASS, mem spike not reproduced
maria: decision: hold full rollout, keep canary pinned and monitor for 2 more hours
ryan: noted, adding 2h watch window and perf alert thresholds
deploy-bot: NOTIFY: rollout status=PAUSED reason=memory_spike_hold monitors=2h owner=@maria ticket=INF-3421
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
jamal: will follow up with a short postmortem if we need rollback later
deploy-bot: FINISHED: sandbox canary step paused; next_action=monitor
